City of Tallahassee Utilities - Residential Energy Efficiency Rebate Program

Last Updated June 23, 2025

Program Overview

  • Implementing Sector:
    Utility
  • Category:
    Financial Incentive
  • State:
    Florida
  • Incentive Type:
    Rebate Program
  • Web Site:
    http://www.talgov.com/you/you-products-home-index.aspx
  • Administrator:
    City of Tallahassee Utilities
  • Utilities:
    City of Tallahassee
  • Eligible Renewable/Other Technologies:
    Solar Water Heat
  • Eligible Efficiency Technologies:
    Clothes Washers, Dishwasher, Refrigerators/Freezers, Water Heaters, Lighting, Furnaces, Heat pumps, Air conditioners, Programmable Thermostats, Building Insulation, Pool Pumps
  • Applicable Sectors:
    Residential
  • Incentive Amount:
    Efficient HVAC Rebates
    Air Conditioners (Tier 1): $100
    Air Conditioners (Tier 2): $350
    Heat Pumps (Tier 1): $100
    Heat Pumps (Tier 2): $350
    Heat Pumps (Tier 3): $750
    Heat Pump Water Heater: $300

    ENERGY STAR Appliance Rebates
    Dishwasher: $40
    Freezer: $40
    Refrigerator: $75
    Clothes Washer: $100
    Pool Pump: $200

    Natural Gas Appliance Upgrades
    Ranges and Ovens: Up to $200
    Clothes Dryer: Up to $200
    Furnace: Up to $700
    Tank or Tankless Water Heaters: Up to $675

    Natural Gas Appliance Replacements
    Ranges and Ovens: Up to $150
    Clothes Dryer: Up to $150
    Furnace: Up to $350
    Tank or Tankless Water Heaters: Up to $300

    Solar Water Heater: $450
    ENERGY STAR New Home and Renovation: $1/Square Foot
  • Maximum Incentive:
    ENERGY STAR New Home and Renovation: $2,000

    Natural Gas
    $2,000 Gold Package Bonus applies to first-time installations of a water heater, furnace [or a combination appliance], and either a gas range or dryer, all installed in one job at the same time.
  • Equipment Requirements:
    Efficient HVAC Rebates
    Air Conditioners (Tier 1): Split systems SEER2 15.2, EER2 12.0 (Package units SEER2 15.2, EER2 11.5)
    Air Conditioners (Tier 2): Split systems SEER2 17.1, EER2 12
    Heat Pumps (Tier 1): Split systems SEER2 15.2, EER2 11.7, HSPF2 7.8 (Package units SEER2 15.2, EER2 10.6, HSPF2 7.2)
    Heat Pumps (Tier 2): Split systems SEER2 17.1, EER2 12.0, HSPF2 8.0 (Package units SEER2 15.2, EER2 11.0, HSPF2 7.8)
    Heat Pumps (Tier 3): EER 17.1 and COP 3.6 (closed loop); or EER 21.1 & COP 4.1 (open loop)
    Heat Pump Water Heater: ENERGY STAR Certified. Rebate unavailable if replacing natural gas water heating

    ENERGY STAR Appliance Rebates
    Dishwasher: ENERGY STAR Certified.
    Freezer: ENERGY STAR Certified.
    Refrigerator: ENERGY STAR Certified.
    Clothes Washer: ENERGY STAR Certified.
    Pool Pump: ENERGY STAR Certified.

  • Ownership of Renewable Energy Credits:
    City of Tallahassee Utilities

Summary

City of Tallahassee Utilities (CTU) offers residential customers rebates for ENERGY STAR appliances, Efficient HVAC Systems, ENERGY STAR homes, Solar Water Heaters, and Natural Gas Appliances.

Visit the CTU website for more detailed information about any of these rebates.

About DSIRE®

DSIRE is the most comprehensive source of information on incentives and policies that support renewables and energy efficiency in the United States. Established in 1995, DSIRE is operated by the N.C. Clean Energy Technology Center at N.C. State University and receives support from EnergySage.
